question: How should the rite be performed according to means?
premises: In every way it is to be performed.
In absence of wealth, again to be done even with kusha bound.
inference: The rite is performed according to means, and even kusha-bound materials suffice when wealth is absent.
uncertainties: The exact minimum materials are not specified.
plain_english: In every way it is to be performed according to means; in absence of wealth, again to be done even with kusha bound.
